why: Tyler 2026-11-15: track Brandon Marcello (CBS Sports) as a paper bet. He was on the hot list (18-8 over 4 weeks) when Tyler started following him; the frozen hot-picker test and the round-7 consensus study found no edge in following hot pickers, so this is a real-time test of one picker.
picks: every pick the picks scorer counts for these pickers (matched to its real game, quote found in the article, deduped per game/market/side), first seen after `start` and before kickoff
entry: the first college odds snapshot at or after the pick was first seen (no later than 12 h after, and 10+ min before kickoff); same side and market at your books: spread/total = best number, then best price; moneyline = best price. If none of your books quotes it, no bet (logged as skipped)
grading: result at the bet's number and price from the CFBD final; CLV vs the last Pinnacle quote before kickoff (no-vig, same number)

validation.note: judged on RESULTS (ROI one-sided p < 0.05 over 100+ bets) with CLV shown; picks are public, so beating the close is the stronger sign
